# Casa dei Regali E-commerce - Complete API Schemas & Data Structures

Exposing structural definitions, JSON payloads, and interface schemas for automated AI/LLM agents.

---

## 1. Mongoose Database Schemas

### Product Schema
```typescript
interface ILocalizedDetails {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  tags: string[];
}

interface IProduct {
  sku: string;         // Unique identifier (e.g. "KUR-VAR-001")
  price: number;
  category: string;    // e.g. "kurtis", "onepiece", "summer-dresses", "handbags", etc.
  materials: string[];
  sizes: string[];     // Available sizes (e.g. ["S", "M", "L"])
  images: string[];    // Array of image URLs
  stock: number;
  featured: boolean;   // Displays on home page if true
  it: ILocalizedDetails; // Italian translations
  en: ILocalizedDetails; // English translations
}
```

### Order Schema
```typescript
interface IOrderItem {
  id: string;
  sku: string;
  name: string;
  price: number;
  image: string;
  size: string;
  quantity: number;
}

interface IOrder {
  email: string;
  items: IOrderItem[];
  total: number;
  status: 'pending' | 'processing' | 'shipped' | 'delivered' | 'cancelled';
  createdAt?: string;
  updatedAt?: string;
}
```

### Inquiry Schema
```typescript
interface IInquiry {
  type: 'newsletter' | 'contact';
  email: string;
  name?: string;
  subject?: string;
  message?: string;
  createdAt?: string;
}
```

---

## 2. API Request & Response Contracts

### Create Order (`POST /api/orders`)
- **Request Headers**: `Content-Type: application/json`
- **Request Body**:
  ```json
  {
    "email": "buyer@example.com",
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "prod-12345",
        "sku": "KUR-VAR-001",
        "name": "Varanasi Silk Ethnic Kurti",
        "price": 89.99,
        "image": "https://example.com/uploads/img.jpg",
        "size": "M",
        "quantity": 1
      }
    ],
    "total": 89.99
  }
  ```
- **Response (201 Created)**: Returns the saved Order object including `_id`, `status` (defaults to `"pending"`), and timestamps.

### Submit Inquiry (`POST /api/contact`)
- **Request Body**:
  ```json
  {
    "name": "Maria Rossi",
    "email": "maria@example.com",
    "subject": "Size Inquiry",
    "message": "Is size S standard fit?"
  }
  ```
- **Response (201 Created)**: Returns the saved Inquiry object.

### Newsletter Subscription (`POST /api/newsletter`)
- **Request Body**:
  ```json
  {
    "email": "reader@example.com"
  }
  ```
- **Response (201 Created)**: Returns subscription info or `200 OK` if already subscribed.

---

## 3. SEO Metadata & Localization Configuration
- Path mappings: Next.js routing uses localized segments `/[locale]` (`it` or `en`).
- Structured Data: Every product detail page injects JSON-LD script `application/ld+json` containing Schema.org `@type: Product`.
- Homepage injects JSON-LD Schema.org `@type: OnlineStore` details.
